Meryer (Shanghai) Chemical Technology Co., Ltd. is a chemical enterprise based in Minhang District, Shanghai, China, one of the country’s most dynamic centers for industry, innovation, and international trade. Located in Shanghai, a city known for its strong manufacturing base and advanced logistics network, the company benefits from a strategic position that supports efficient cooperation with domestic and overseas customers. Meryer is engaged in the chemical field with a focus on providing products, technical support, and related solutions for a wide range of industrial and commercial applications.

As a company operating in the highly specialized chemical sector, Meryer (Shanghai) Chemical Technology Co., Ltd. is positioned to serve clients who require reliable chemical materials, professional service, and responsive supply capabilities. The company emphasizes product quality, operational efficiency, and customer-oriented cooperation. By combining industry knowledge with a practical understanding of market demand, Meryer aims to build long-term partnerships with customers in research, manufacturing, processing, and other related sectors.

Minhang District offers an excellent environment for chemical and technology-oriented businesses, with convenient transportation links, access to skilled professionals, and close connections to Shanghai’s broader commercial ecosystem. This location enables Meryer to respond quickly to customer needs and maintain smooth business communication across regional and international markets.

With a commitment to steady development, professional service, and continuous improvement, Meryer (Shanghai) Chemical Technology Co., Ltd. works to strengthen its presence in the chemical industry and to deliver value through dependable products and cooperative business relationships. The company reflects the energy and capability of Shanghai’s modern industrial landscape while pursuing growth through quality, credibility, and service.
